<summary><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://github.githubassets.com/static/images/icons/copilot-code-review/medium-v2-dark.svg"><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="https://github.githubassets.com/static/images/icons/copilot-code-review/medium-v2-light.svg"><img src="https://github.githubassets.com/static/images/icons/copilot-code-review/medium-v2-light.png" alt="Medium severity" width="62" height="18" align="texttop"></picture> Secondary reviewer may share the author&#39;s vendor</summary>

`skills/​cork-cross-review/​SKILL.md:77`

This excludes the author's vendor only from *primary* review, but Step 4 allows a secondary reviewer merely by requiring it to differ from the primary. A Claude-authored PR could therefore still use a Claude lane as its second reviewer, violating the non-negotiable different-vendor rule and the skill's advertised contract. Remove the author's vendor family from the kept review roster entirely.
